questions.stem: A 40-year-old woman reports experiencing recurrent headaches that last between 6 and 48 hours. She often feels fatigued and has mood changes before the headaches begin. According to the International Headache Society's criteria, which features are essential for diagnosing her condition as migraine?

options.label: B
options.text: Unilateral pain with photophobia without nausea

options.label: D
options.text: Bilateral pain with photophobia and nausea
